hero.origin_badge: 🇨🇭 Made in Switzerland — for the whole world
hero.pill: DRIVERS WITH A PURPOSE · YOUR CAR · YOUR WAY HOME
hero.lede: Rotabo connects you with a driver who believes nobody should drive home unfit — and who gets you there in your own car.
hero.cta_home_screen: ⬇ Add Rotabo to your home screen
hero.fine: Works in your browser — no app store needed.

problem.h2: The problem with every other option
problem.cross3: No coming back for it tomorrow.
problem.cross4: No second ride to collect it.
problem.thesis: Just you, your car, and the way home.

how.step3_desc: They drive your car, with you in it.
how.step4_desc: You arrive together. The car stays yours the whole way.
how.not_taxi1: Not a taxi. Not a ride. Not a car left behind.

safety.h2: Drivers who drive for a reason
safety.check1: Every driver joins to keep someone off the road who shouldn't be on it
safety.check2: Identity and licence confirmed before the first journey
safety.check3: A shared code of conduct, agreed by everyone who drives
safety.check4: Share your live journey with anyone you choose
safety.check5: Rate every driver, report any incident

partners_card.p: Let your guests enjoy the evening and still drive home in their own car. Offer Rotabo at the table, at reception, or at the door.

drivers_card.p: Every journey you take is one nobody takes badly. Choose your own hours, drive cars you never have to own, and get people home the way they wanted to go.

supporters.p: Rotabo is kept going by anyone willing to stand behind the idea that nobody should drive when they shouldn't.

footer.legal: Rotabo is a technology platform. Drivers are independent providers, not employees of Rotabo.

install_modal.title: Add Rotabo to your home screen
install_modal.generic: Open your browser's menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install_modal.ios: Tap the Share icon in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".

find_form.title: Find a driver
find_form.subtitle: Tell us who you are and where you are. You'll pay the platform contribution next, then we start searching.
find_form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

drive_form.title: Become a driver
drive_form.subtitle: Create your driver profile. You'll pay the platform contribution next, then you can start browsing requests.
drive_form.license_year_label: Year you obtained your driving licence
drive_form.decl1: I hold a valid driving licence for the relevant vehicle categories.
drive_form.decl2: I am legally permitted to drive in the country where I offer rides.
drive_form.decl3: I will never accept or perform a ride while impaired by alcohol, drugs, or any other substance.
drive_form.decl4: I understand that I drive entirely at my own responsibility and that of the client.
drive_form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

searching_page.searching_body: Hang tight — we'll connect you with a driver as soon as one accepts your request.
searching_page.pending_body: This usually takes just a few seconds.
searching_page.no_request_body: We couldn't find a request on this device. If you just paid, this can take a few seconds — refresh this page. Otherwise, start a new request from the home page.
searching_page.cancelled_body: You can start a new request any time from the home page.
searching_page.matched_body:
{driver_name} has accepted your request. From here, you two take it from here — agree on the details directly. The remaining fare is settled between you, in cash or by card.

Thank you for choosing not to drive tonight. That's what Rotabo is about.

dashboard_page.title: Open requests
dashboard_page.subtitle: Requests currently searching for a driver in {city}.
dashboard_page.not_registered_body: You don’t have a driver profile on this device yet.
dashboard_page.empty_note: No open requests in your city right now. This list refreshes automatically.
dashboard_page.taken_note: That request was just taken by another driver.
dashboard_page.active_ride_sharing_on: Sharing your live location with the client.
